title: Clinical ORM entities
goal: Show persistent clinical entities and their appointment relationships.

rubric.must: Patient, Practitioner, Appointment, and Clinic have generalization arrows pointing to abstract BaseEntity.
Appointment has a filled composition diamond to AppointmentNote.
Appointment has directed associations to both Patient and Practitioner with visible multiplicities.
AppointmentRepository is visibly an interface with a dashed dependency to Appointment.
AppointmentStatus visibly lists scheduled, cancelled, and completed states.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the umlclass exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly shows the required inheritance, appointment relationships, note composition, repository dependency, and status values. Connections are traceable and labels readable, with no material overlaps or cropping.

items.evidence: Patient, Practitioner, Appointment, and Clinic connect through generalization lines to the abstract BaseEntity; the hollow triangle points to BaseEntity.
A filled diamond at Appointment connects to AppointmentNote, labeled notes, with multiplicity 0..* at the note end.
Appointment has directed associations to Patient and Practitioner, labeled patient and clinician; both show 0..* at the Appointment end and 1 at the person end.
AppointmentRepository is marked «interface» and has a dashed dependency labeled persists pointing to Appointment.
AppointmentStatus is marked «enumeration» and lists SCHEDULED, CANCELLED, and COMPLETED.
